question: I originally didn’t realize that Mr. Pete was a spirit, and if Beatrice didn’t say anything, she’d simply be a loli, so are there perhaps spirits that have blended in with humans?
answer: There aren’t many spirits that deliberately take human shape, so probably not. In the same way that Puck has the form of a cat, those who can chose the form they prefer don’t often want to take human form. Petelgeuse attached himself to humans out of necessity, and Bea-ko was designed by Echidna, as well.
